title: Editor E0 task 11: node ops, a per-node write guard and a node render resolver, pure and proven, before any writer switches
detail: Decomposed from PROG-E0 on 2026-10-19 (owner: "Fan out and start building everything"; ADR-1325 sequence 9 → 10 → 11). lib/entity-blocks/node-ops.ts: the rows-ops mutations performed on nodes by nid (addNode from the palette refusing an unknown type or a type at its cap; placeNode, nudgeNode, benchNode to the stored bench with bags intact, hideNode/unhideNode for one node, removeNode, setNodeContent/setNodeStyle), every result re-run through normalizeNodeLayout (deterministic re-mint of a missing or duplicate nid from coordinates, positional row-id regeneration, per-type cap across placed rows, bench cap). sanitizeNodeLayout(raw, kind) reads any shape through upgradeLayout, rewrites each known node's bags through its own sanitizeBlockContent/sanitizeBlockStyle, drops a wrong-kind known type, preserves an unknown type byte-for-byte (ADR-978), folds too-wide rows onto the kind maximum. resolveNodeRows is the node-shaped resolveRows. There is no Record keyed by nid anywhere, so no user-originated write key (EDITOR-E0 §1.2, CodeQL js/remote-property-injection). No writer, renderer or editor switches: the LIVE-875/877/887 boundaries stand until task 12 and task 14 adopt these behind render_path.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const s=fs.readFileSync('lib/entity-blocks/node-ops.ts','utf8');const bad=[];for(const f of ['normalizeNodeLayout','addNode','placeNode','nudgeNode','benchNode','hideNode','unhideNode','removeNode','setNodeContent','setNodeStyle','sanitizeNodeLayout','resolveNodeRows'])if(!s.includes('export function '+f+'('))bad.push('missing '+f);if(!s.includes('sanitizeBlockContent(node.type'))bad.push('known bags are not sanitized per node');if(/Record<\s*string,\s*BlockNode\s*>/.test(s))bad.push('a node map keyed by id is back');if(!fs.existsSync('lib/entity-blocks/node-ops.test.ts'))bad.push('no test');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1000: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when a node op, the write guard or the resolver is gone, when known bags stop going through the per-type field sanitizer, or when a Record keyed by node id appears. The behaviour (bags travel, unknown types round-trip, corpus identities survive) is node-ops.test.ts in the test job.
